records.name: Gyroscope GYD
records.identity_decision: GYD is the base Gyroscope reserve-backed stablecoin launched on Ethereum; sGYD is a separate yield-bearing representation and not an alias.
records.backing_decision: GYD is designed to be fully backed by a diversified basket of protocol-controlled reserve assets with risk-diversification rules and automated risk controls.
records.redemption_decision: Official material documents minting and redemption through the frontend and smart contracts using protocol bonding-curve mechanisms; jurisdictional frontend access and exact reserve-asset outputs require normalization.
records.income_decision: No intrinsic holder yield is established for base GYD. Yield-bearing treatment belongs to the separate sGYD representation and liquidity strategies.
records.deployment_decision: Ethereum is the canonical full-protocol launch network. Polygon Gyro Proto is historical and must not be merged into the Ethereum deployment without an explicit lineage relationship.
blocking_unknowns: canonical token and reserve contract map

records.name: f(x) Protocol fxUSD
records.identity_decision: fxUSD is the base f(x) Protocol stablecoin. fxSAVE is a separate tokenized stability-pool vault, while xPOSITION, sPOSITION, stability-pool shares, and CreditNotes are separate position or receipt products.
records.backing_decision: Current protocol documentation describes fxUSD as fully collateralized and on-chain, with stETH and WBTC position collateral and a USDC/fxUSD stability pool supporting peg operations.
records.redemption_decision: Official documentation states that fxUSD can be minted and redeemed at oracle prices and redeemed for backing collateral; implementation routes and V1/V2 pool-specific constraints require contract-level normalization.
records.income_decision: Official documentation associates sustainable on-chain yield with the fxUSD system, but direct base-token accrual versus yield delivered through fxSAVE or stability-pool participation remains unresolved and must not be inferred.
records.deployment_decision: An Ethereum fxUSD address is documented for protocol 2.0. V1/V2 continuity, replacement boundaries, and the complete canonical contract set require a reviewed deployment map.
blocking_unknowns: complete collateral and position contract map

records.name: Berachain HONEY
records.identity_decision: HONEY is Berachain's native base stablecoin. HONEY borrowed through Bend remains the same asset, while vault receipts, liquidity positions, and bridged representations require separate relationship treatment.
records.backing_decision: HONEY is fully collateralized by governance-whitelisted stablecoin collateral held in asset-specific vaults. Governance may designate custodians, so custody and reserve location must be represented separately from token identity.
records.redemption_decision: Users can mint and redeem HONEY against supported collateral through HoneySwap. Basket Mode changes redemption into a proportional basket when collateral instability is detected, and fees vary by collateral asset.
records.income_decision: Base HONEY has no documented intrinsic holder yield. Mint and redeem fees accrue to BGT holders, while Bend supply positions and reward vaults are separate income-bearing products.
records.deployment_decision: Berachain mainnet is the native deployment. HoneyFactory and related mainnet contracts are documented; Bepolia is testnet and must not be represented as a canonical production deployment.

records.name: QiDAO MAI
records.identity_decision: Official QiDAO documentation identifies MAI as the stablecoin previously called miMATIC, supporting one continuous asset identity across the rebrand. Chain-specific token representations still require deployment-level mapping.
records.backing_decision: MAI is backed by overcollateralized crypto-asset vaults and may also be minted against approved stablecoins through Peg Stability Modules.
records.redemption_decision: Vault borrowers repay MAI to reduce debt and release collateral. Peg Stability Modules provide permissionless one-to-one minting and queued redemption against approved stablecoins, with documented fees and a withdrawal delay.
records.income_decision: Base MAI has no documented intrinsic holder yield. Yield generated by Peg Stability Module collateral strategies is protocol-side income rather than automatic holder accrual.
records.deployment_decision: MAI is deployed across multiple chains with chain-specific addresses and bridge risks. A canonical chain and contract inventory is required before promotion; identical symbol use alone does not prove canonicality.
blocking_unknowns: exact original launch and rebrand dates

records.name: Stables Labs USDX
records.identity_decision: This record is limited to the Stables Labs and usdx.money USDX token. The reused USDX symbol does not merge unrelated assets, and sUSDX is a separate ERC-4626 staking representation.
records.backing_decision: USDX uses a delta-neutral portfolio of crypto spot assets and offsetting derivatives positions, with backing assets handled through off-exchange settlement and multiple custody or exchange counterparties.
records.redemption_decision: Direct minting and redemption are restricted to approved KYC/KYB entities. Official documentation describes direct redemption into USDT after a seven-day period, while general holders rely on external liquidity pools.
records.income_decision: Base USDX does not automatically distribute protocol yield. Yield is allocated through the separate sUSDX staking vault, whose value accrues through protocol revenue transfers.
records.deployment_decision: The official documentation identifies an Ethereum USDX token contract and separate sales, redeem, and sUSDX contracts. Additional deployments and any bridge representations require review.
